The ecological devastation on Heard Island demonstrates that the virus is moving faster than the state's ability to respond.
Research shows that 75% of southern elephant seal pups on Heard Island have died from H5N1 bird flu, marking the first detection of the virus in an Australian territory.

The 'sobering' reality is that we are witnessing a mass extinction event in real-time, and the government's focus is on mainland protection rather than ecosystem preservation.

Social Physics Analysis:
This is a classic case of 'out of sight, out of mind.' The state only acknowledges the threat once it reaches a threshold that threatens the mainland, ignoring the collapse of the sub-Antarctic ecosystem.
